purpose: Public, curator-selected association pages monitored for changes. These are research watches, not qualified leads or new RFPs.

sources.label: Summer 2027 conference calendar change
sources.needle: The Conference is currently being shifted to Summer 2027
sources.next_action: Ask whether the summer 2027 move reopened any venue, vendor or full-service planning decisions. Verify conference scope and hotel demand.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The Conference is currently being shifted to Summer 2027.

sources.label: Attendee-input process for recurring conferences
sources.needle: Help NAO Shape Your Conference Experience
sources.next_action: Determine whether feedback from the latest Nonprofit Impact Conference is being used to change fall 2027 event planning. Confirm internal event staff and hotel agreements.

sources.label: 2029 hotel proposals under review
sources.needle: reviewed proposals from Turning Stone and Resorts World Catskills
sources.next_action: Verify whether the 2029 negotiation remains open and whether the committee would welcome an independent total-cost review, despite existing internal planning responsibilities.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The committee also reviewed proposals from Turning Stone and Resorts World Catskills for the 2029 conference.

sources.label: New executive director and program-operations leadership
sources.needle: Renee Johnson
sources.next_action: Determine whether new leadership changed oversight of the summer 2027 conference, rather than assuming the new director will outsource planning.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The Arkansas Education Association announced hiring Renee Johnson as executive director in February 2026, overseeing organizational strategy, operations, and program development.

sources.label: 2027 conference cycle and program decision milestones
sources.needle: Nonprofit Impact Conference
sources.next_action: Map the 2027 Nonprofit Impact Conference supplier decision cycle; the posted proposal dates are for speakers, not event management. Check whether event operations are internally staffed.
sources.baseline_excerpt: NAO lists the fall 2027 Nonprofit Impact Conference and other 2027 programs; posted proposal windows concern speakers and session content, not venue sourcing.

sources.organization: New York State Association of Professional Land Surveyors
sources.label: Board financial pressure and changing conference economics
sources.needle: declining revenue from educational programs and rising expenses
sources.next_action: Determine whether the reported association financial concerns apply specifically to conference economics and whether there is an actionable cost review before any hotel decision.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The NYSAPLS executive board reviewed its financial position in July 2026, noting declining revenue from educational programs and rising expenses, while discussing future annual conference locations.

sources.label: Conference site votes three years ahead; 2029 cycle timing check
sources.needle: The ALGA Board of Directors votes to approve future conference sites three years in advance
sources.next_action: Establish whether ALGA's 2029 conference city and hotel have already been approved; confirm whether its Site Selection Subcommittee permits independent sourcing advice. 2026-2028 cities are already announced.
sources.baseline_excerpt: ALGA's board approves conference sites three years ahead. As of February 2026, 2026 Cleveland, 2027 Denver and 2028 St. Louis were selected; 2029 status was not established by this source.

sources.label: Recurring hybrid annual conference and hundreds of attendees
sources.needle: 2027 ALGA Annual Conference in Denver
sources.next_action: Research whether the 2029 annual event has an open venue decision and who manages vendor agreements; site subcommittee owns selection.
sources.baseline_excerpt: ALGA advertises the May 2–5, 2027 hybrid annual conference in Denver, which draws hundreds in person and online.

sources.label: FY2025 $1.10M revenue supports financial fit
sources.next_action: Use the filed FY2025 Form 990 and audited statements to distinguish total nonprofit revenue, $615,052 conference revenue and $454,130 conference expenses. Conference margin is not an assumed savings opportunity.
sources.baseline_excerpt: FY2025 Form 990, EIN 23-2539807: total revenue $1,101,786; independently audited FY2025 statements list $615,052 conference revenue and $454,130 conference expenses.

sources.organization: Council of Academic Programs in Communication Sciences and Disorders
sources.label: Board reviewed conference revenue and cost reduction, February 2025
sources.needle: Revenue generating and cost reduction strategies for the conference were discussed
sources.next_action: The financial discussion is from February 2025, not a fresh 2026 trigger. Look for current board action, 2028 venue sourcing dates, and whether cost review can be outsourced despite internal staff.
sources.baseline_excerpt: CAPCSD board minutes for February 9–11, 2025 say the board discussed future conference financial implications, revenue-generation and cost-reduction strategies, including evaluating tier-one and tier-two cities.

sources.organization: Council of Academic Programs in Communication Sciences and Disorders
sources.label: 2027 annual conference subsidized; host hotel publicly named
sources.needle: CAPCSD is subsidizing the 2027 annual conference
sources.next_action: Do not pitch 2027 venue sourcing: Atlanta Marriott Marquis is already named. Find the 2028 venue-planning cycle and whether full-service support is open; check current director of professional development and board approval.
sources.baseline_excerpt: Official CAPCSD 2027 conference page says registration fees are subsidized and below actual per-person cost; the March 31–April 3, 2027 meeting is listed at Atlanta Marriott Marquis.

sources.organization: Council of Academic Programs in Communication Sciences and Disorders
sources.label: FY2025 $1.93M revenue verifies financial range
sources.next_action: Confirm legal identity and EIN 63-0784938; ProPublica displays an older legal name. FY2025 total revenue is not conference spend.
sources.baseline_excerpt: FY2025 Form 990, EIN 63-0784938, reports $1,930,497 total revenue. ProPublica uses an older organizational name, requiring an exact EIN identity confirmation.

sources.organization: New York State Association for College Admission Counseling
sources.label: 2029+ host selection historically unresolved and cost-control signals
sources.next_action: Check whether 2029 host negotiations are STILL open as of today. Determine if the college-host planning process permits independent fee-paid venue/cost advice. The May 2026 report is historical, not current contract proof.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The 2025-2026 president's annual report discussed expense pressures and stated future annual conference host agreements after 2028 were not yet signed at that report date. Does not establish their November 2026 status.

sources.organization: New York State Association for College Admission Counseling
sources.label: Multi-year college host history and future annual conference cycle
sources.next_action: Verify two past conferences, expected 2029 event scale and venue model, plus whether campus-hosted logistics leave enough negotiated spend for Robert.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The association's public conference host history identifies prior and forthcoming college campus hosts, including 2027 Keuka College; 2028 hosting was secured. This is event history, not confirmation of an open contract.

sources.organization: North Carolina Association of Municipal Clerks
sources.label: 2029 conference site-selection committee with named chair
sources.needle: Site Selection - 2029
sources.next_action: 2029 has a named committee chaired by Shawne Southard; independently verify site or hotel contract status (two-year planning lead), event attendance, financial scale and whether any outside fee-paid sourcing is permitted.
sources.baseline_excerpt: The NCAMC website lists a Site Selection - 2029 committee chaired by Shawne Southard. The stated responsibility is to recommend the Annual Conference site, date and hotel/motel facility, with contracts normally completed two years before the event.

sources.label: 2027-2029 future site discussion and committee planning
sources.needle: Future conference planning and site selection (2027–2029)
sources.next_action: Read the newest minutes for decisions made after June 2026. Verify meeting size, actual conference budget, college-host preference and ability to pay an outside source advisor before recommending Robert.
sources.baseline_excerpt: HiTOP executive committee minutes list future conference planning and site selection for 2027–2029 among forthcoming discussion items. Earlier minutes discuss uncertainty about conference costs and relying on low-budget university space. These are clues, not an open paid engagement.

sources.organization: National Association of Community Development Extension Professionals
sources.label: 2028 conference host site solicitation for Southern land-grant institutions
sources.needle: NACDEP is currently seeking a site for its 2028 conference
sources.next_action: Check if 2028 site applications remain open; determine whether campus hosts or internal volunteers handle site/logistics, whether Robert could provide independent sourcing, and event-level room and F&B spend.
sources.baseline_excerpt: NACDEP currently seeks a 2028 conference site from land-grant institutions, preferring the Southern region. 2027 Portland was already selected. Host-site applications are not proof of an opportunity for a paid independent planner.

sources.organization: Association for the Study of Higher Education
sources.label: 2030-2031 site selection committee begins late 2026
sources.needle: Site Selection Committee
sources.next_action: Determine if ASHE conference attendance and staffing requirements are realistic for Robert alone. Committee begins 2030–31 location review in late 2026/early 2027; verify purchasing process, outside planner incumbency and budget.
sources.baseline_excerpt: ASHE is recruiting members for its Site Selection Committee, with work expected to start in late 2026/early 2027 reviewing potential locations for its 2030 and 2031 conferences. This may be too far out or complex for Robert.

sources.organization: Indiana League of Municipal Clerks and Treasurers
sources.label: 2028 conference site selection committee appointed
sources.needle: 2028 Conference Site Selection Committee
sources.next_action: Verify 2028 host hotel/venue selection status, decision deadline, conference scale and whether the existing board/municipal association operations staff can consider outside cost assessment.
sources.baseline_excerpt: ILMCT public committees list a 2028 Conference Site Selection Committee chaired by Terri Budde. It does not state that the venue is unsigned or an independent planner is needed.

sources.label: 2028 host location process, 250+ attendees and lodging scale
sources.needle: At this stage, please refrain from soliciting formal bids
sources.next_action: 2028 host LOI process is already underway; hotel bid packets were targeted for November 13, 2026. Verify actual status immediately. Internal end-to-end conference service model is a serious outside-advisor fit concern.
sources.baseline_excerpt: ALP's 2028 conference host selection page reports 250+ attendees and around 150-160 peak hotel nights, with LOIs before hotel bids. Its organizer says ALP provides end-to-end conference services. Hotel sourcing is likely near or past its earliest buying window.
counterevidence_flags: ALP publicly describes managing end-to-end conference services internally
Host LOI process is already public; hotel bids scheduled November 2026
